sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The Brucebase wiki's song list (brucebase.wikidot.com/stats:songs) is now supported, when switched on: ⚙️ Settings → 📚 Brucebase → Enable on the Brucebase song list (off by default). A Songs button turns the page's 28 letter tabs into one filterable, sortable table with Title and Letter columns, one row per song: the songs the site's "Alt." tab lists a second time are not repeated and keep the letter of their main title. Nothing is fetched.
